snippet.title: Pixel Aquarium - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the free demo & wishlist the full version on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3916380/Pixel_Aquarium/

In this casual idle simulator, you take care of charming pixel-art fish, collect coins to buy decorations that provide uniques bonusses, and create your dream Pixel Aquarium!
